inputs.root_cause: SAL-UBL-OBL-237188D47391391E (UBL-EDIT-001)'s own missing_behavior disclosed two remaining items after its FIRST-occurrence insertion capability was built: (1) add_component()'s first-occurrence insertion requires the optional 'xmlschema' dependency at runtime, falling back to unconditional refusal without it; (2) the module has no opinion on a new component's own internal field structure.
